title: Voyager AI
body: The intelligence layer across Identity, Payments, Ramp, Messaging, and Discovery. Search relays, sign listings, and parse payments — in your browser.

title: Voyager Pay
body: Open payments protocol. Custody-free, identity-free Lightning rail over signed Nostr events. A federation of Mostro nodes does the market-making.

title: Voyager MCP
body: An MCP server so AI can consume the Nostr kind directory. Stateless read lens over the SDK — listings, stalls, ramp quotes, DMs — exposed as MCP resources.
